summary: Iteration 3 tested new Excel Import feature end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_import.py covering (a) fuzzy header mapping variants ['DATE ','AMOUNT','CATEGORY','Mode','DETAILS'] and ['Expense Date','Amt','Head','PaymentMode','Remarks'] both mapping correctly; (b) validation: negative amount and empty amount → 'Amount must be a positive number', bad date invalid, fully empty rows counted in empty_skipped not total_rows; (c) unsupported files: .csv and .txt return 400 with 'Only .xlsx / .xls / .xlsm files supported'; missing required column returns 400 'Missing required columns: ...'; (d) duplicate detection: case-insensitive signature date|amount|category|description flagged correctly (dup vs unique); (e) commit skip_duplicates=true imports only valid non-dup (imported=1, skipped=1, failed=1 for negative amount); (f) commit skip_duplicates=false imports duplicates (imported=1, skipped=0); (g) sample file /tmp/all_expenses.xlsx yields EXACTLY {total_rows:180, valid:172, invalid:8, duplicates:0, empty_skipped:0} with new_categories=['OTHERS'], commit imports 172 in 0.26s (<30s perf budget); (h) after import, /api/expenses/summary/dashboard + analytics/monthly/category/weekly/payment all 200; (i) regression: /api/resources still returns 19 seeded. Frontend: btn-import-excel visible on /expenses next to Excel/PDF/Print/Backup/Restore; opens import-dialog; import-pick-file + import-file-input work; uploading /tmp/all_expenses.xlsx transitions to Preview step; chip-total=180, chip-valid=172, chip-duplicates=172 (all previously-imported rows now dupes), chip-invalid=8; preview-tbody rendered 180 rows; toggle-invalid-only correctly filters to 8 rows; Confirm Import (0) shown because skip_duplicates ON + all valid are dups; commit succeeded → result-total=180, result-imported=0, result-skipped=172, result-failed=8; import-done closes dialog; toast 'Imported 0 expenses' shown; Expense History table refreshed showing OTHERS category rows (custom category preserved). Manual expense/edit/delete/filters/budget/export/backup untouched (regression suite from iteration 2 still green).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1030 lines; the Excel-import block (~340 lines) is a good candidate to split into routers/expenses_import.py plus a services/excel_parser.py module.

_existing_signatures() loads up to 200,000 expense docs on every preview and every commit call. Fine for a few thousand rows but O(N) per call; consider a MongoDB unique compound index on {date, amount, category, description} (case-insensitive collation) and rely on duplicate-key errors instead, or maintain the signature in the document itself.

import_commit does not validate rows through the Expense pydantic model - it re-implements validation. If Expense model rules change (e.g., description length, payment_mode enum), import path will silently drift. Consider constructing Expense(**doc) before insert_many for defense-in-depth.

Preview endpoint returns the full parsed rows[] to the client and expects them back on commit. For 180 rows this is fine, but for 10k+ row imports this is a large round-trip. Consider server-side caching keyed by an upload token, or streaming commit.

Duplicate detection uses only date+amount+category+description; two legitimate identical expenses on the same day cannot both be entered via import. Consider also including payment_mode or letting user opt-in per-row.

load_workbook uses read_only=True which is good, but data_only=True means formula cells return None if not evaluated by Excel yet. If a user uploads a file generated by libreoffice/python that has unevaluated formulas, amount cells could silently be None.
seed_data_creation: Imported ~172 historical expense rows from /tmp/all_expenses.xlsx into MongoDB via sample-file test (as approved). Also inserted+deleted a handful of TEST_-prefixed rows for duplicate/commit tests (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New Excel Import backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_import.py (12 tests). Endpoints: POST /api/expenses/import/preview (multipart file) + POST /api/expenses/import/commit (json {rows, skip_duplicates}). Duplicate signature = date|round(amount,2)|category.lower()|description.lower(). Sample file /tmp/all_expenses.xlsx has been already imported into DB (~172 rows, CATEGORY=OTHERS custom category) so any future preview of the same file will show 172 duplicates - clear /api/expenses first if a clean run is needed. Frontend flow: /expenses → btn-import-excel → import-dialog → import-pick-file / import-file-input → chip-* + preview-tbody + toggle-skip-duplicates + toggle-invalid-only → import-confirm → result-* → import-done.
